## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; Internal Rotation by the stated breadth thresholds, with defensive sectors positive while Technology and Industrials lag on the week. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); mixed sector and timeframe signals offer no confirmation for a stronger regime call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads on the week (+2.87%), but remains below its one-month level (-7.06%); COP (1W: +5.19% | 1M: -3.46%) and EOG (1W: +4.74% | 1M: -1.61%) are in RECOVERY. Communication (+2.06%) and Consumer Staples (+1.72%) also lead: CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%) and COST (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +12.77%) are ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary is weakest (-3.24%), with ROST (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -5.87%) and F (1W: -6.47% | 1M: -5.79%) BELOW TREND. Technology (-2.56%) and Materials (-2.64%) also lag: NVDA (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -27.08%) and FCX (1W: -11.46% | 1M: -20.64%) are BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%), CME (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +8.68%), COST (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +12.77%), CMCSA (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +16.89%), and AVGO (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +1.41%) are all ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); the concentration signal is not narrow.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ROST (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -5.87%), ETN (1W: -5.95% | 1M: -13.63%), F (1W: -6.47% | 1M: -5.79%), INTC (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -38.26%), and GM (1W: -6.67% | 1M: -0.35%) are BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Consumer Discretionary, Industrials, and Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best one-week momentum: CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +5.19% | 1M: -3.46%) RECOVERY, and CME (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +8.68%) ABOVE TREND. COP and EOG (1W: +4.74% | 1M: -1.61%) are short-term rebounds against negative monthly returns; watch for follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak, with sector returns of -2.56% for the week and -8.94% for the month; the supplied data does not include Technology stock-level breadth. AVGO (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +1.41%) is ABOVE TREND, while MSFT (1W: -4.99% | 1M: -2.09%), NVDA (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -27.08%), GOOGL (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -16.70%), and META (1W: -2.33% | 1M: -11.69%) are BELOW TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed: sector returns were -0.19% for the week but +2.56% for the month; stock-level breadth was not supplied. CME (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +8.68%) and AIG (1W: +3.92% | 1M: +2.49%) are ABOVE TREND, while JPM (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -0.44%) is BELOW TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed: the sector fell 0.92% on the week but gained 4.15% over the month; stock-level breadth was not supplied. UNH (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +2.64%) and LLY (1W: +1.52% | 1M: +14.03%) are ABOVE TREND, while CVS (1W: +3.92% | 1M: -3.39%) is in RECOVERY.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Stay selective in this NEUTRAL regime: favor demonstrated strength in Communication and Consumer Staples, while monitoring persistent Technology weakness. Style mixed / no clear leadership; reduce exposure to lagging names such as NVDA (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -27.08%) BELOW TREND, rather than making a broad Growth-versus-Value shift.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%) ABOVE TREND; monitor for continuation, and watch CME (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +8.68%) ABOVE TREND for sustained financial leadership. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -27.08%) and INTC (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -38.26%) are BELOW TREND; stabilization would be needed to ease downside pressure.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (+2.06% weekly; +4.62% monthly) and Consumer Staples (+1.72%; +5.57%) have positive returns across both periods. BEARISH: Technology (-2.56%; -8.94%) and Consumer Discretionary (-3.24%; +4.51%) show weekly weakness; breadth remains 4/11 sectors positive overall.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not provided. Monitor whether NVDA (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -27.08%) BELOW TREND stabilizes, whether CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%) ABOVE TREND sustains its advance, and whether COP (1W: +5.19% | 1M: -3.46%) RECOVERY extends beyond its short-term bounce.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
DIS (+40): Jefferies sees cost reductions supporting earnings growth; price and trend data were not supplied, so confirmation cannot be assessed. No other bullish-sentiment SP100 names in the supplied headlines had matched price data available for cross-reference.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AVGO (-45): tighter chip rules cited as a pressure; AVGO (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND, so price action diverges from the negative headline. CSCO (-50), NFLX (-45), and WFC (-35) had negative headlines, but their 1W/1M returns and trend labels were not supplied, preventing price confirmation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, with style mixed and no clear leadership; breadth is 4/11 sectors positive and leadership is Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). CHTR (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +26.19%) and CME (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +8.68%) are ABOVE TREND, while NVDA (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -27.08%) is BELOW TREND. Monitor the Technology drawdown and AVGO’s (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +1.41%) positive price performance against its negative news sentiment.
